title: Only Eyes Has a new job

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: This is Ivan Iker McGuire, coming to you live from Eastern Residential, the heart of all the action.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is Ivan Iker McGuire, coming to you live from Eastern Residential, the heart of all the action.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Never better! The radio station you mentioned offered me a job. Apparently their previous announcer went insane.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never better! The radio station you mentioned offered me a job. Apparently their previous announcer went insane.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I am well. The announcer you mentioned, Mr Reston, has been rather helpful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am well. The announcer you mentioned, Mr Reston, has been rather helpful.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Noted. The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Noted. The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: I confess I am struggling with the concept. You are a meat-person with auditory abilities, tell me: what would brutalize your eardrums in an acceptable manner?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I confess I am struggling with the concept. You are a meat-person with auditory abilities, tell me: what would brutalize your eardrums in an acceptable manner?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Yes, he is leaving the radio industry for existential reasons and recommended me to his old station!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, he is leaving the radio industry for existential reasons and recommended me to his old station!

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: He says he can no longer abide the crushing weight of reality. It is a wonderful opportunity for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He says he can no longer abide the crushing weight of reality. It is a wonderful opportunity for me.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The station has asked me to create a new show. Something that will "punch people's eardrums through the backs of their skulls".

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: ... really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... really?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Really? And what about when I mention meteorological events?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? And what about when I mention meteorological events?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Well then, perhaps I won't. I will pitch this to the station immediately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well then, perhaps I won't. I will pitch this to the station immediately.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: You think people would send compromising information for me to read on air?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think people would send compromising information for me to read on air?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Fascinating. What would I call such a project?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fascinating. What would I call such a project?

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Crude, but compelling. I will pitch it to the station immediately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crude, but compelling. I will pitch it to the station immediately.

nodes.speaker: Only-Eyes McGuire
nodes.text: Witty. I like it. I will pitch it to the station immediately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Witty. I like it. I will pitch it to the station immediately.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How are you doing, Ivan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you doing, Ivan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, stay away from CameoPOV if they approach you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, stay away from CameoPOV if they approach you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, stay away from CameoPOV if they approach you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, stay away from CameoPOV if they approach you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's great!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glad to hear it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, he's leaving?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, he's leaving?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's great.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The shipping forecast.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The shipping forecast.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anonymous confessions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anonymous confessions.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. The way you talk about atmospheric pressures does things to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. The way you talk about atmospheric pressures does things to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. The way you talk about atmospheric pressures does things to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. The way you talk about atmospheric pressures does things to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. Don't stop.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Don't stop.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Absolutely. Everyone loves a mucky secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely. Everyone loves a mucky secret.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Absolutely. Everyone loves a mucky secret.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Absolutely. Everyone loves a mucky secret.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: McGuire's Fess Hole?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: McGuire's Fess Hole?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Only Ears?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only Ears?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you're doing good, Ivan!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you're doing good, Ivan!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you're doing good, Ivan!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you're doing good, Ivan!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. I love it if radio is all about the facts, no nonsense!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I love it if radio is all about the facts, no nonsense!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. I love it if radio is all about the facts, no nonsense!
